exposure: ultrasound guided needle aspiration of breast abscess
incision and drainage of breast abscess
cohort: 60 patients with breast abscess were divided into two groups: one undergoing ultrasound-guided aspiration and the other incision and drainage.
finding: Ultrasound-guided needle aspiration was found to be superior to incision and drainage for breast abscess management in terms of hospital stay time, procedure time, cosmetic output, and post-operative pain.
